translation: Does the world rest me? If the world does not rest me, I rest the world. Rest, and rest! Rest where one should rest, rest where one joyfully rests, rest where one cannot but rest; what is called willing to rest and not willing to rest? Only I did not expect that sixty years ago, the person I yearned to see, I would come to embody. Is it principle? Is it fate? Is it Heaven? Is it man? What is done without doing is Heaven; what is brought about without bringing is man.
